import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()

    # Ensure proper dtypes
    events["event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(events["event_ts"])

    # Order within user: event_ts, then event_id
    df = events.sort_values(["user_id", "event_ts", "event_id"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    # Previous event timestamp within same user
    prev_ts = df.groupby("user_id")["event_ts"].shift()

    gap = df["event_ts"] - prev_ts
    gap_minutes = gap.dt.total_seconds() / 60.0

    same_date = df["event_ts"].dt.date == prev_ts.dt.date

    is_new_session = (
        prev_ts.isna()
        | (gap_minutes > 45)
        | (~same_date)
    )

    # Session number per user: cumulative count of session starts
    df["session_num"] = is_new_session.groupby(df["user_id"]).cumsum().astype("int64")

    grouped = df.groupby(["user_id", "session_num"], sort=False).agg(
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    grouped["session_date"] = grouped["session_start"].dt.date

    result = grouped[
        ["user_id", "session_num", "session_date", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
    ].sort_values(["user_id", "session_num"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"user_sessions": result}
